column1: # name<TAB>arguments (shell words, run in this directory; "< file" = stdin). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 blast_formatter (ws, env_blast, the conda build), 2026-11-20, ad-RG-F3-1 (line RG item F3), every row under unshare -rn: no row reaches NCBI's servers.

# in/bn.asn: blastn -query in/q.fa -subject in/s.fa -outfmt 11 -out in/bn.asn (NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0, same day); in/q.fa and in/s.fa by remaining-gaps-20261112/F/f3 (impl_b.md). conf/malformed.ini is that of tests/convert2blastmask. Run without LOSAT_, NCBI_ and BLAST variables but NCBI_CONFIG_PATH (this directory) and BLAST_USAGE_REPORT=false (NCBI only).

# Not frozen: -version and the full versions (LOSAT prints its own, NCBI's forms with LOSAT's package; tests/ncbi_toolkit_version.rs), -xmlhelp (LOSAT's XML is NCBI's without -rid, which LOSAT refuses at the run; tests/ncbi_toolkit_help.rs, against NCBI's frozen XML src/ncbi_xmlhelp/blast_formatter.xml), -rid with a value (NCBI asks its servers; LOSAT refuses it, src/blast_formatter/run_tests.rs), an unreadable -archive (git keeps no file mode that hides a file from its owner; NCBI's text is that of a missing file, probe P3.124), a standard output that cannot be written (NCBI's runtime aborts: src/blast_formatter/archive_tests.rs and the test blast_formatter_standard_output_failure_aborts of tests/masker_fixtures.rs, from probes of agent C6, 2026-11-23), and of the output formats other than 8, 9 and 12 only NCBI's own checks (of13_no_out, of17_blastp_sam) and one refusal by name (refused_of6) for the rest.

# Rows from of8_db on (line RG item F3 PR 1, agent C5 of ad-RG-F3-5, 2026-11-23): NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0, the official release build on the local machine (ws was down), by remaining-gaps-20261112/F/f3/tools/fixC.py, every NCBI run under unshare -rn. Their archives were written by NCBI's own programs: in/db.asn, in/batch.asn (BATCH_SIZE=1), in/warn.asn (-max_target_seqs 1, BATCH_SIZE=1) and in/pd.asn (-parse_deflines) by blastn -query in/q2.fa -db in/db/s3 -outfmt 11 (in/db/s3: makeblastdb -blastdb_version 4 of in/s3.fa, which holds in/s.fa, a copy with a change every 40 letters and its second half; in/q2.fa holds in/q.fa and a part of in/s.fa); in/err.asn (blastn -task blastn -reward 1 -penalty -2 -gapopen 0 -gapextend 0: an error object); in/ps.asn (psiblast -query in/ps.faa -db ../db_search/paja -num_iterations 2; in/ps.faa = residues 251-290 of tests/fasta/psiblast/tk.faa); in/rps.asn and in/rtn.asn (rpsblast -query in/rps.faa = tests/fasta/psiblast/tk.faa, rpstblastn -query in/rtn.fna = the second record of tests/fasta/rps/nq4.fna, -db in/rps/rps_mini, the files of tests/db_search/rps/rps_mini that a protein database open reads); in/soft.asn (blastn -db_soft_mask 11 on a dustmasker-masked database made elsewhere; in/m/db is the same sequence without its mask) and in/nodb.asn (a database that is not here). Made from them by fixC.py: in/garbage.asn (in/db.asn and a line), in/cut2.asn (in/batch.asn cut in its second object), in/empty.asn, in/fatal.asn (in/warn.asn with its first message's severity 4). @OUT@ is a new directory of each run; the files a run leaves there follow its standard output in ncbi/<name>.out. refused/<name>.err is LOSAT's refusal by name; ncbi/<name>.* keeps NCBI's bytes (refused_fatal_message's trace names the local binary).

# Rows from of8_delta on (line RG item F3 PR 1, agent C6 of ad-RG-F3-5, 2026-11-23): NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0, the official release build on the local machine, by remaining-gaps-20261112/F/f3/tools/fixC6.py, every NCBI run under unshare -rn. in/delta.asn and in/phi.asn: the first object of in/ps.asn with its service changed to delta_blast and phi (review of PR 1, F3/review/c_tmp/scripts); in/tax_both.asn and in/tx5_both.asn: in/db.asn with a taxid list and a negative taxid list, on in/db/s3 and on in/txdb/t (makeblastdb -in in/s3.fa -dbtype nucl -taxid 9606 -blastdb_version 5, in the review); in/bad1.asn and in/bad2.asn: in/batch.asn with a byte 0x07 in a query title of its first and of its second object (the line of the post counts over the file). in/real_pinf.asn and in/real_nan.asn (tools/fixC6b.py): in/bn.asn with its first e-value PLUS-INFINITY and NOT-A-NUMBER; refused_real_9 and refused_real_12 are LOSAT's refusals by name of such a value (NCBI writes it in ASN.1 binary and stops at it in JSON).

# Rows from opt_bho09_8 on (line RG item F3 PR 1, agent C7 of ad-RG-F3-5, 2026-11-24): NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0, the official release build on the local machine, by remaining-gaps-20261112/F/f3/tools/fixC7.py, every NCBI run under unshare -rn. in/opt_<name>.asn is in/bn.asn with one option of its search added or changed to a value that a search program's option check refuses (BestHitOverhang 0.9, BestHitScoreEdge -1, Culling 1 with best hit, Culling -1, MaxHspsPerSubject -1, PercentIdentity 150, QueryCovHspPerc 150, WordSize 3 and -1, an e-value of 0, HitlistSize 0): blast_formatter builds the options of each object without checking them, and only the hit list size changes what it writes.
